name: academic-poster-builder
title_zh: 把论文变成学术海报，还能审稿式挑错
tagline_zh: 从 LaTeX、PDF 到 HTML，一张图不丢、公式不错位。它连空白和溢出都替你盯，改到能投会议为止。
tagline_en: Turn papers, LaTeX, or PDFs into polished posters—fixing overflow, blank space, and typography until it's.
desc_en: Build, critique, and refine academic posters from a paper, LaTeX project, reference draft image, HTML/CSS source, PPT/PDF outputs, or local figure assets. Use when Codex is asked to create or improve a research poster, convert a poster design to HTML/PDF/PPTX, fix poster layout/typography/overflow/blank-space issues, or preserve paper figures and result semantics in a poster.
why_zh: 不是模板套壳：它先解析论文语义，再按海报逻辑重排，最后以审稿人视角挑版式毛病。图、公式。
why_en: Not a template wrapper: it parses paper semantics, reflows for poster logic, then critiques like a reviewer—figures, formulas.
limit_zh: 只服务学术海报这一件事：不做演示文稿、不做网页。输入得是论文/LaTeX/PDF/PPT/HTML/图片之一。
limit_en: Academic posters only—no slide decks or web pages. Needs a source file (paper/LaTeX/PDF/PPT/HTML/image); verbal descriptions alone won't trigger it.
